item.description: Course syllabus for Guitar — Planet Leads Academy.

item.title: Holding the Guitar, Tuning Up, and Your First Notes
item.description: From your first tuned string to strumming full songs with confidence. Lesson 1: Holding the Guitar, Tuning Up, and Your First Notes This lesson teaches you how to hold the guitar, tune it, and play your first notes. Everything in this course - chords, strumming, songs - depends on the guitar being…

item.title: Reading Chord Diagrams - Your First Chords (E Minor, A Major)
item.description: Lesson 2: Reading Chord Diagrams - Your First Chords (E Minor, A Major) This lesson teaches you to read chord diagrams and play your first two chords: E minor and A major. Chords are the heart of guitar playing - strum a chord and you are already making music that sounds like songs. Reading a…

item.title: Strumming - Patterns, Rhythm, and Timing
item.description: Lesson 3: Strumming - Patterns, Rhythm, and Timing This lesson teaches you strumming: how to move your right hand across the strings in steady rhythmic patterns. Chords give you the notes; strumming gives you the groove. A great strum pattern can make two simple chords sound like a real song, while…

item.title: The Essential Open Chords (G, C, D, E Minor, A Minor)
item.description: Lesson 4: The Essential Open Chords (G, C, D, E Minor, A Minor) This lesson teaches you the five essential open chords: G, C, D, E minor, and A minor. With these five shapes you can play thousands of songs in the keys of G, C, D, and A minor - this is the working vocabulary of the rhythm guitarist.…

item.title: Switching Chords Smoothly + Your First Full Song
item.description: Lesson 5: Switching Chords Smoothly + Your First Full Song This lesson turns your chords and strumming into your first full song. You will learn the techniques that make chord changes sound smooth - anticipation, pivot fingers, and rhythmic continuity - and then play an original two-part song…

item.title: Single Notes - The Minor Pentatonic Scale
item.description: Lesson 6: Single Notes - The Minor Pentatonic Scale This lesson teaches you single-note playing through the minor pentatonic scale - the five-note scale behind countless melodies and solos in rock, blues, and folk music. Until now every note you played was part of a chord; now your fingers learn to…

item.title: Finger Exercises and an Intro to Barre Chords
item.description: Lesson 7: Finger Exercises and an Intro to Barre Chords This lesson builds finger strength and independence with targeted exercises, then introduces barre chords - the movable shapes that unlock every key on the guitar. Open chords only work in a few keys; a barre chord is a shape you can slide up…

item.title: Your Practice Routine + Five Songs to Learn Next
item.description: Lesson 8: Your Practice Routine + Five Songs to Learn Next This lesson gives you a permanent practice routine and five songs to learn next. You now own the complete beginner toolkit: tuning, open chords, strumming patterns, smooth changes, single-note scales, and the beginnings of barre chords.…
